subject: copr: fix the issue about runaway index lookup query blocking (#56920)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. The change makes the small-task channel optional and guards send/close paths so when runaway cooldown sets `smallTaskConcurrency=0`, small tasks no longer get routed into an unserved channel (previously could block/hang). Added failpoint regression test (`issue56916`) covering the blocking scenario. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/data consistency/concurrency/runtime handling, and later history up to `upstream/master` doesn’t show a follow-up fix specifically correcting this change.
